pictures.author: Mark Ahsmann
pictures.observed: Courtyard view with Agas Mosque left and Library right. Dormitory/Privy Chamber arcade extends beyond the Mosque: pale pointed arches, slender grey shafts, low lead roofs/polygonal shallow crowns. Independent large domed Sacred Relics chamber beyond retained.

pictures.author: Maksym Kozlenko
pictures.observed: Oblique dormitory colonnade: pale ashlar wall, rectangular barred lower windows, smaller arched upper openings, grey circular shafts with pale capitals, pointed open bays, iron ties and repeated low polygonal lead crowns. Taller domed Holy Mantle chamber at far end is independent.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Has Oda Kogusu/Dormitory of the Privy Chamber on OSM way103907804: irregular elongated footprint, pale stone rear range and short angled southern connector, open courtyard colonnade with slender grey shafts/pale capitals/pointed arches, two window rows, low lead main roof and repeated shallow polygonal portico crowns. Preserve the independent Agas Mosque and large domed Sacred Relics chambers. No copied inscriptions, visitors, garden props or furnished museum interior.
